Crystal Guardians

Released August 1, 2006 · 100 cards

Crystal Guardians is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the EX series, released in English on August 1, 2006. It has 100 cards. It includes 82 Pokémon, 17 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

27 illustrators worked on Crystal Guardians. Most cards: Masakazu Fukuda (8), Mitsuhiro Arita (8), Hisao Nakamura (7), Kouki Saitou (7), Kagemaru Himeno (6), Ryo Ueda (6), Atsuko Nishida (5), Hajime Kusajima (5).
